title: Evaluating the Knowledge Base Completion Potential of GPT
benchmark_measurement: Knowledge of an entity's religious affiliation, tested via the 'hasReligion' relation in a knowledge base completion task.
findings: In a retain-all setting, GPT-3 (text-davinci-003) achieved a precision of 0.73 for the 'hasReligion' relation, but in a high-precision setting (R@P90), its recall dropped to 0.02, indicating difficulty in generating high-confidence facts about religion.
